newsitem.title: UK: Baltic/Black Sea oil exports up 14,320 bpd on week.
newsitem.headline: Baltic/Black Sea oil exports up 14,320 bpd on week.

text.p: Total exports of crude oil and refined products from Baltic and Black Sea terminals rose by some 14,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 1.86 million bpd in the second week of April, consultants Petro Logistics said in a report on Monday.
The total was around 185,000 down on the same week last year.
The Geneva-based consultancy, tracking tanker movements, said crude oil exports from Baltic and Black Sea ports fell by nearly 175,000 bpd from the previous week to 933,000 bpd.
This was nearly 19,000 bpd up on year-ago levels.
Heavy fuel exports were 307,000 bpd, a rise of around 63,000 bpd on the week, and a gain of 155,000 bpd on the year.
Gas oil exports were 60,000 bpd up week-on-week and 90,000 bpd up year-on-year, at 470,000 bpd.
